sourceNotes.rawContent: Add a modern edge to your look with these gold-toned stainless steel hoops, featuring a chic embossed pattern. These high-fashion earrings provide an instant style upgrade. To preserve their brilliant golden finish, ensure they stay dry, avoid contact with perfumes, and store them in a dry place after use.
